description: Inherited table name to Vaultix vx_<group>_<entity> name (docs/0119). Frozen history: rows are never removed.

groups.auth: People signing in: users, sessions, MFA, SSO configuration, API keys
groups.identity: Machine identities and their authentication methods
groups.workspace: Organizations, projects, environments, memberships, roles and groups
groups.secrets: Secrets, folders, versions, snapshots, imports, tags, rotation and dynamic secrets
groups.policy: Approval policies and requests, access requests and validation rules
groups.connect: App connections, syncs, integrations, webhooks, migrations and proxied services
groups.net: Gateways, relays and resource authentication for network access
groups.pki: Certificate authorities, certificates, profiles, enrollment and SSH certificates
groups.kms: Key management, external KMS, HSM and KMIP
groups.ai: AI and MCP servers, endpoints and activity
groups.operate: Audit logs, notifications, alerts, queues and instance configuration
groups.public: Public, pre-sign-in surfaces such as early-access requests
